title: Modeling information acquisition: divergences, duality, and discrete choice
abstract: arXiv:2510.03482v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce a new cost function over experiments, f-information, based on the theory of multivariate statistical divergences, that generalizes Sims's classic model of rational inattention as well as the class of posterior-separable cost functions. We characterize its behavioral predictions by deriving optimality conditions that extend those of Matejka and McKay (2015) and Caplin, Dean, and Leahy (2019) beyond mutual information. Using these tools, we study the implications of f-information in a number of canonical decision problems. The framework can be analyzed using familiar methods of microeconomics---convex duality and the Arrow-Pratt approach to expected utility---and yields connections to well-known models of discrete choice.

translated_title: 信息获取建模：散度、对偶性与离散选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.03482v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们引入了一种新的实验成本函数——f-信息，基于多元统计散度理论，它推广了Sims的经典理性疏忽模型以及后验可分成本函数类。通过推导扩展了Matejka和McKay（2015）以及Caplin、Dean和Leahy（2019）超越互信息的最优性条件，我们刻画了其行为预测。利用这些工具，我们研究了f-信息在若干典型决策问题中的含义。该框架可以通过熟悉的微观经济学方法——凸对偶性和期望效用的Arrow-Pratt方法——进行分析，并与已知的离散选择模型建立联系。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于散度理论的新型信息获取成本函数f-信息，统一并推广了理性疏忽模型，并通过凸对偶和Arrow-Pratt方法揭示其与离散选择模型的深层联系。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new cost function over experiments, f-information, based on multivariate divergence theory, generalizing rational inattention models and revealing connections to discrete choice via convex duality and Arrow-Pratt methods.
